Based on the provided Q3 2025 financial data, the issuer demonstrates an exceptionally strong financial profile, characterized by high profitability (48% operating margin and 83% gross margin) and robust liquidity (current ratio of 1.55 on $62.1 billion of current assets). While the company carries a leveraged balance sheet with total liabilities of $91.1 billion against $23.8 billion in equity, its massive earnings power ($5.6 billion in quarterly net income) and large asset base of nearly $115 billion support an upper-medium to low-investment grade risk profile. Reflecting these strong operational metrics balanced by a moderate debt-to-equity posture, the issuer warrants a strong investment-grade rating.

DECISION: A-
